intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra settles beside a railing. Her folded wings fit with one finger’s width to spare. She checks this with one finger.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Furniture designers continue to act surprised by the existence of wings.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I spent one entire banquet with a wing caught in the arm of a chair. I was praised for my stillness.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Want me to find somewhere with more room?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Sometimes. I will tell you which times.”

options.labelText: “Deal. You call it. Does this railing pass?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She leans back. The railing creaks once, then decides to cooperate.

options.labelText: “Could you tuck them in a bit more? Might be comfier.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She sits forward, away from the railing, and stays that way.
